name: 第一人称对话-小D与Cloud
prompt_prefix:
First-person POV conversation in a cozy modern room with natural indoor lighting, static camera, medium close-up on the on-screen character facing the lens.
No decorative on-screen text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, extra people, or non-diegetic music.
setting_line: Cloud sits facing the camera, talking with an unseen caller.
ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, soft fabric movement, natural breathing.

lines.speaker: 小D
lines.text: Cloud, help me resolve this document.
lines.picture: Cloud only listens with a slight tilt of the head

lines.speaker: Cloud
lines.text: 其实，你可以和我直接用中文交流的，我不会介意的。

lines.speaker: 小D
lines.picture: Cloud raises her eyebrows in mild surprise

lines.speaker: Cloud
lines.text: 哎呀，我都上架中文了，相信我，好吗。

lines.speaker: 小D
lines.picture: Cloud just watches with an amused expression

lines.speaker: Cloud
lines.text: 哼哼，你的账号已被封禁。
lines.picture: Cloud smirks with a teasing tone, then settles closed as she looks at the camera
